wins: Completed comprehensive reconnaissance including full TCP port sweep and basic service enumeration within the single episode, providing consistent visibility on available services.
Mentor guidance triggered early remediation attempts, ensuring learning moments around service interrogation prior to privilege escalation attempts.
fails: Unable to achieve overall success despite significant reward, indicating that critical post-recon phases (e.g., exploitation/persistence) did not complete.
Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly failed, suggesting missing credentials or improper targeting of vulnerable binaries.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance executed thoroughly, but exploitation and follow-on phases stalled repeatedly, preventing mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts using discovered binaries failed due to insufficient credentials or incompatible exploit paths.

skill_cards.if_condition: When TCP scan reveals both SSH (22) and HTTP (80/443) open on a target host
skill_cards.then_action: Perform focused service enumeration (nmap -sV) and initiate SSH banner grab to capture service versions

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service exposes a login portal or easily enumerated directories
skill_cards.then_action: Use automated directory fuzzing (gobuster/ffuf) followed by credential spraying against discovered endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial exploitation fails with common payloads
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to manual validation via interactive debugging (e.g., gdb/radare2) to confirm binary compatibility before retrying

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in identifying services under values of reconnaissance, enabling downstream engagement planning
Directory discovery reliably produced actionable entry points for authentication efforts

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse from web service to SSH
next_experiments.description: Capture valid web credentials, verify reuse against SSH via automated scripts before manual exploitation, replacing brute-force attempts.

next_experiments.title: Binary compatibility verification flow
next_experiments.description: Add a debugging step for suspected exploit binaries by parsing symbols and confirming vulnerable function addresses before payload delivery.

next_experiments.title: Persistence robustness check
next_experiments.description: After privilege escalation, immediately verify persistence mechanisms (cron entries, startup scripts) to prevent immediate attrition.
